evidence: The actual reader active callback now requires its own request generation and tab lifetime. Modal Cancel/Escape/replacement, Profile reload, parking and tab drop invalidate request ownership.

A running reader keeps the slot until its matching result. Repeated requests coalesce into one latest-only PendingRead carrying the initiating immutable Profile context; stale callbacks cannot publish or free a newer slot.

Cancellation of a remote caller is not confused with remote worker completion. ForecastCompletion acquires a ticket synchronously before worker scheduling and holds it around the full remote::exec invocation, including pool/connect waits. Nested cleanup spawns inherit their own tickets before parent release.
Replacement dispatch checks both the retained running slot and the actual completion counter, without a wall-clock cooldown assumption. The counter releases on closure return/unwind.

Independent injected-dispatcher tests prove real Escape cancellation with tab alive,100 replacements starting only newest request, stale callback rejection, Profile/dialog/drop invalidation, and a replacement blocked after simulated caller timeout until the underlying recording worker completes.
